headline: AMD Stock Rallies on Expanded Meta AI Infrastructure Deal
summary: Advanced Micro Devices shares rallied following an expanded agreement with Meta to supply AI infrastructure and a broader semiconductor market recovery.
why: AMD is a major designer of high-performance microprocessors and graphics processors, competing directly with Nvidia in supplying data centers for artificial intelligence.

impacts.name: Advanced Micro Devices
impacts.why: Securing a major infrastructure deal with a hyperscaler like Meta validates AMD's AI hardware roadmap and drives revenue growth.

why_moved: A major expansion of its AI hardware supply agreement with Meta directly boosts revenue expectations and investor confidence in AMD's competitive positioning in chips.
